reply.text: That's a symptom, and it's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach. I can't tell you whether barbell work is safe this week, and I won't guess at it. Get it looked at, and once they've cleared you, tell me what they said and I'll build the training around it. In the meantime, I can keep going on the side that's mine: if you want, I'll check your recent sessions so we know what's been loaded lately.
